summary:
Iter 92 — TestFlight round-7 (Feb 2026) surgical bug-fix verification. All three approved fixes verified exactly as specified. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (test_iter92_composer_and_stt.py). Frontend: static verification confirms all changes match spec; Metro bundles cleanly (1629 modules, ~3.7s, zero errors); home screen renders without red screen. NO deprecated packages, NO scope creep detected.

Fix A (Nearby Opt-In row tappable) — profile.tsx lines 367-384: single Pressable wraps checkbox View + label Text, minHeight:44, hitSlop:8, accessibilityRole='checkbox', accessibilityState={{checked:nearbyOptedIn}}, testID='toggle-nearby-opt-in' preserved. Backend PATCH /api/users/{id}/preferences with {nearby_chat_alerts:true|false} persists and reads back correctly (2/2 tests).

Fix B ('No friends' guidance) — profile.tsx lines 585-598: inline block gated on `alertAudience === 'friends' && friends.length === 0`, renders title 'You don't have any friends yet' + body + Pressable testID='alert-friends-find-friends' that calls setAlertOpen(false) + router.push('/friends'). Existing Send catch toast (line 654-656) still present as fallback. Backend POST /api/community/chat-alert with audience='friends' + 0 friends returns 200 {ok:true, audience:'friends', delivered_to:0, message:'You don't have any friends yet — try sending a friend request first.'} — matches frontend expectation.

Fix C (Composer standardisation via shared VoiceInputButton) — VoiceInputButton.tsx lines 92-102 declare new optional props (onSend, voiceEnabled=true, sendDisabled, sendTestID) and destructure them at 124-127. Send branch at lines 384-415 renders `Ionicons name='send'` inside 44pt round Pressable (backgroundColor c.brand) when `onSend != null && !isRecording && !isBusy && (hasText || !voiceEnabled)`. Backwards compat verified: group/[id].tsx caller omits `onSend`, always renders mic branch. Callers updated cleanly: dm/[id].tsx (line 118-128, testIDs dm-mic/dm-send, NO wrapping voiceInputEnabled gate), table/[id].tsx (line 348-358, testIDs table-voice/table-send, photo button still separate), recipes/[id].tsx (line 173 justifyContent:'flex-end', line 180-191 sole child with recipe-comment-voice/recipe-comment-send + sendDisabled={!text.trim() || posting}, prefs destructured at line 18). group/[id].tsx unchanged — still shows separate <VoiceInputButton> + <Pressable testID='group-post-submit'> Post button (line 67-81, space-between). GeorgeEventCreation.tsx unchanged — does not use VoiceInputButton at all. 

STT contract (Garry's explicit ask): POST /api/mcgs/george/transcribe — 401 without Bearer ✓, 422 without 'file' field ✓, 200 {text: string} with valid file + Bearer ✓. VoiceInputButton static path (line 283 url = `${BACKEND_URL}/api/mcgs/george/transcribe`, line 310/317 form.append('file', …) on BOTH web and native branches, line 327 Authorization: `Bearer ${tok}` when yb_token present) unchanged from iter91 and still intact after the composer refactor.

Physical-device native mic recording remains out-of-scope for Playwright (iOS AVAudioSession + real microphone required) — Garry will exercise on next TestFlight build.
action_items: None required from the three-fix scope — all approved changes verified. Physical-device native mic verification (real recording → /api/mcgs/george/transcribe → transcript into TextInput) must be performed by user on next TestFlight build. Contract is confirmed intact on both backend and frontend static paths.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix A: single Pressable correctly wraps checkbox+label (no nested Pressable). minHeight:44 + hitSlop:8 comfortably exceeds iOS HIG touch-target. accessibilityState={{checked}} correctly declared.

Fix B: empty-state block sits INSIDE the modal above the message input and Send button — order is fine, doesn't hide the send button when block renders. Send button still active but returns the helpful backend message via existing toast path, so both paths converge on 'nudge to Find Friends' UX. Correct.

Fix C: VoiceInputButton send branch preserves accessibilityLabel='Send message', disabled state when !hasText via sendDisabled ?? !hasText default. Correctly reuses same 44pt round shape as mic for visual consistency. useCallback deps arrays untouched (userId still in stopAndTranscribe deps — harmless carryover from iter91, out of scope).
group/[id].tsx: intentionally still uses the old dual-button pattern with a text 'Post' button — matches the requirements ('group has a distinct Post text button, keep visual placement unchanged').
No new deprecated Expo APIs introduced. expo-audio (not expo-av) already in use in VoiceInputButton line 62-67 — good.
Nothing altered outside the three approved scopes was observed (verified by grep and diff-style comparison against iter91 report).

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 pytest — 2 preferences persistence, 1 chat-alert fallback, 3 STT contract)
success_rate.frontend: 100% static verification (Metro clean, all Fix A/B/C code matches spec exactly, home screen renders without errors)
